meta.title: REBP Portal
meta.description: Register, get licensed and verify Real Estate Brokerage Practitioners and Firms.

brand.name: REBP Portal
brand.body: Professional Body for Real Estate Brokerage Practitioners

landing.title: Your trusted front door to real estate licensing
landing.subtitle: Apply, track your application in real time and get a verifiable electronic licence — from your phone, in your language.
landing.verifySubtitle: Check any licence by name or number in seconds.
landing.categoriesSubtitle: The portal shows only what applies to you.

account.title: Create your account
account.body: Verify your email and phone, and turn on two-step verification.

apply.title: Complete the guided form
apply.body: Answer only the questions for your category. We save as you go.

pay.title: Sign, pay and submit
pay.body: Pay online and track every step of the review.

license.title: Get your e-licence
license.body: Download a certificate with a QR code anyone can verify.

trust.accessible: Works on any phone, in English, Kinyarwanda and French

categories.title: Professional categories
categories.subtitle: Compare what each category may do and what it needs.

RERA.name: Real Estate Referral Agent
RERA.summary: Refers clients to licensed practitioners. Referral-only (Article 10).

FSLA.name: Field Sales and Leasing Agent
FSLA.summary: Entry-level field practitioner working under supervision.

REA.name: Real Estate Agent
REA.summary: Requires at least 3 years as an FSLA or a recognised equivalent.

BROKER.name: Real Estate Broker
BROKER.summary: Requires at least 3 years as a licensed Real Estate Agent.

ASSOCIATE_BROKER.name: Associate Broker
ASSOCIATE_BROKER.summary: A licensed Broker affiliated with a firm under a Principal Broker.

MANAGING_BROKER.name: Managing Broker
MANAGING_BROKER.summary: A licensed Broker who manages an office or branch of a firm.

PRINCIPAL_BROKER.name: Principal Broker
PRINCIPAL_BROKER.summary: Responsible for a firm's supervision, client funds, records and compliance.

REBF.name: Real Estate Brokerage Firm
REBF.summary: A legal entity licensed to carry on brokerage, led by a Principal Broker.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.draft: Draft text pending approval by the Professional Body's Legal & Compliance Officer.
privacy.body: We collect the personal data needed to register and license real estate brokerage practitioners and firms, and to maintain the public register. We collect each item only when your category or application type requires it. Your data is encrypted, access is limited to staff with a need to know, and every access to sensitive records is logged. Only the fields listed in the register rules are ever published. You can request a copy of your data at any time.

emailVerify.subject: Your REBP Portal verification code: {code}
emailVerify.body:
Hello {name},

Your email verification code is {code}. It expires in 10 minutes.

If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

phoneVerify.subject: REBP verification
phoneVerify.body: REBP Portal: your phone verification code is {code}. It expires in 10 minutes.

mfaLoginCode.subject: Your REBP Portal sign-in code: {code}
mfaLoginCode.body: REBP Portal: your sign-in code is {code}. Never share it. If this wasn't you, change your password.

mfaEnrolCode.subject: Confirm two-step verification: {code}
mfaEnrolCode.body: REBP Portal: your code to turn on two-step verification is {code}.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your REBP Portal password
passwordReset.body:
Hello {name},

Your password reset code is {code}. It expires in 10 minutes.

If you didn't ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email — your password stays the same.

passwordChanged.subject: Your REBP Portal password was changed
passwordChanged.body:
Hello {name},

The password for your REBP Portal account was just changed. If this wasn't you, reset your password immediately and contact support.

mfaChanged.subject: Two-step verification settings changed
mfaChanged.body:
Hello {name},

The two-step verification settings on your REBP Portal account were changed. If this wasn't you, contact support immediately.

contactChanged.subject: Your mobile number was changed
contactChanged.body:
